name: GENTING
recent: Genting Berhad 正在推进一项可放弃供股计划，拟筹集约 RM1,250 million，并已向 Bursa Securities 提交上市申请。同时，公司董事及主要股东在 10 月份有多笔股权变动申报。最新财报显示，2026 年第二季度营收环比增长 16.2%，但净亏损为 RM27.1 million。
notable: 公司提议可放弃供股，拟筹集约 RM1,250 million。
公司已就供股新股向 Bursa Securities 提交上市及报价申请。
Bursa Securities 就供股计划发出询问，公司已作出回复。
risks: 供股计划可能摊薄现有股东持股比例。
公司最新季度录得净亏损 RM27.1 million。
董事及主要股东在 10 月份有多笔股权变动申报。
earnings: 2026 年第二季度营收为 RM7,746.1 million，环比增长 16.2%，同比增长 14.2%；净亏损为 RM27.1 million，净利率为 -0.3%，而上一季度净利率为 1.5%。

recent_en: Genting Berhad is proceeding with a renounceable rights issue to raise approximately RM1,250 million and has submitted a listing application to Bursa Securities. Meanwhile, there were multiple filings of changes in director and substantial shareholder interests in October. The latest financial results show 2Q 2026 revenue grew 16.2% QoQ, but the company recorded a net loss of RM27.1 million.
notable_en: The company proposed a renounceable rights issue to raise approximately RM1,250 million.
The company has submitted an application to Bursa Securities for the listing and quotation of the rights shares.
Bursa Securities issued a query on the proposed rights issue, and the company has responded.
risks_en: The proposed rights issue may dilute existing shareholders' shareholding.
The company recorded a net loss of RM27.1 million in the latest quarter.
There were multiple filings of changes in director and substantial shareholder interests in October.
earnings_en: 2Q 2026 revenue was RM7,746.1 million, up 16.2% QoQ and 14.2% YoY; net loss was RM27.1 million with a net margin of -0.3%, compared to a net margin of 1.5% in the previous quarter.
